title: 第3章 枯血老人第4章 斩断尘缘
content_zh:
“您，请吩咐。”
阿丑埋着头回答，只要能活下来，其他都是小事情。
血袍老人并未直接开口，他一手背在身后，围着阿丑缓缓转圈，目光轻轻闪动，不时盯着阿丑看上两眼。
直到将阿丑看的浑身不自在，心头忐忑不安的时候，他才终于停下脚步，缓缓开口。
“你叫什么名字？”
“他们都叫我阿丑。”
阿丑埋着头小声回答，虽然对方看起来不再像之前那样冷冰冰，但他心中的畏惧却一点没有变少。
“阿丑？你没有其他名字？”血袍老人眉头微微皱起。
“模糊记得有一个，不过已经好多年没人提起过了。”
“叫什么？”
“韩林。”
阿丑想了想，从记忆最深处，找到这个连自己都快要忘记的名字。
“韩林么……”
血袍老者轻声呢喃一句，微微点头，继续道：“行，韩林，现在老夫有一个任务要交给你去办……”
“我有一件宝贝，名叫血灵碗，因为某些原因此碗落到了归元宗的手里……”
这血袍老者自称是枯血老人，给韩林缓缓讲述起任务内容。
大致意思就是，归元宗拿走了这位枯血老人的宝贝，他自己没法进去拿，所以让韩林混入归元宗，打探血灵碗下落，并将其带出来。然后顺便给韩林讲述了一些修行方面的粗浅知识。
韩林听后，不仅明白了对方意图，同时也不由得精神一振。
修仙！
没想到，自己竟有仙人之资。

这是他以前想都不敢想的事情。
虽然潜入归元宗偷东西，是一件十分危险的事情，但总比在凡尘三餐不饱，处处受人冷眼的好吧？
而且，偷血灵碗之事不过口头答应而已，若事不可为，大不了把这老家伙给卖掉，让归元宗的仙人来收拾对方就行了！
想到此处，韩林当即弯腰道：“晚辈一定尽力而为！”
枯血老人道：“不是尽力！是一定要发挥出你的作用，每隔三年出来给老夫汇报一次任务进度，但凡给老夫发现你偷懒，嘿嘿……”
说着，他突然一抬手，将一道红色印记打入韩林眉心之中。
韩林瞬间感觉到，自己脑袋里面有无数根银针来回飞刺，头疼得快要裂开了，捂着脑袋惨叫不已。
枯血老人冷笑道：“这是我的独门咒法，旁人不可能解得了，如果你表现不错，老夫自会帮你解除，否则定叫你神魂俱灭！”
“是，是是……”
韩林冷汗直冒，心头那一点小心思，也伴随着剧痛消失的无影无踪。
这老魔头当真老谋深算！
见韩林识趣，枯血老人也不再折磨他，继续为他普及起修行常识，好让韩林能够快速融入修行一途。
待到差不多了，这才让他下山自己去归元宗。
韩林自然不知道归元宗在哪。
不过枯血老人早有安排，让他去附近的双河镇，说正月十五这天，会有归元宗之人到那里挑选仙苗。
他只需要准时去参加，跟着归元宗的流程走，必定能顺利加入。
content_en:
"Please give me your orders."
A Chou buried his head and answered that as long as he could survive, everything else was a trivial matter.
The old man in blood robe did not speak directly. He put one hand behind his back and slowly circled A Chou. His eyes flickered slightly, and he stared at A Chou from time to time.
It wasn't until A Chou felt uncomfortable and uneasy that he finally stopped and spoke slowly.
"What's your name?"
"They all call me A Chou."
A Chou buried his head and answered in a low voice. Although the other party no longer looked as cold as before, the fear in his heart did not diminish at all.
"A Chou? You don't have another name?" The old man in blood-robed frowned slightly.
"I vaguely remember one, but no one has mentioned it for many years."
"What's it called?"
"Han Lin."
A Chou thought for a while, and from the deepest part of his memory, he found this name that he had almost forgotten.
"Han Lin..."
The old man in blood-robed murmured softly, nodded slightly, and continued: "Okay, Han Lin, now I have a task for you to handle..."
"I have a treasure called the Blood Spirit Bowl. For some reason, this bowl fell into the hands of the Guiyuan Sect..."
The old man in blood robe claimed to be the old man with withered blood, and slowly told Han Lin the contents of the mission.
The general meaning is that the Guiyuan Sect took away the treasure of the withered old man. He couldn't get it himself, so he asked Han Lin to sneak into the Guiyuan Sect, find out the whereabouts of the Blood Spirit Bowl, and bring it out. Then he told Han Lin some superficial knowledge about cultivation.
After hearing this, Han Lin not only understood the other party's intention, but also felt refreshed.
Cultivation!
Unexpectedly, he had the talent of an immortal.
This was something he had never dared to think about before.
Although sneaking into Guiyuan Sect to steal things is a very dangerous thing, but it is better than living in the mortal world without enough food and being looked down upon everywhere, right?
Moreover, the matter of stealing the Blood Spirit Bowl is just a verbal agreement. If things cannot be done, the worst case scenario is to sell this old guy and let the immortals of Guiyuan Sect take care of him!
Thinking of this, Han Lin immediately bent down and said: "This junior must do his best!"
The withered-blooded old man said: "It's not about trying your best! It's about playing your role and reporting the progress of the mission to me every three years. If I find you being lazy, hehe..."
As he spoke, he suddenly raised his hand and struck a red mark between Han Lin's eyebrows.
Han Lin instantly felt that there were countless silver needles flying back and forth in his head. His head was so painful that it was about to split. He covered his head and screamed in agony.
The old man with withered blood sneered: "This is my unique spell. It is impossible for others to solve it. If you perform well, I will help you solve it, otherwise you will be completely destroyed!"
"Yes, yes yes..."
Han Lin broke into a cold sweat, and the little thought in his heart disappeared without a trace along with the severe pain.
This old devil is really cunning!
Seeing that Han Lin was interested, the withered-blooded old man stopped torturing him and continued to popularize the knowledge of spiritual practice for him, so that Han Lin could quickly integrate into the practice.
When it was almost done, he was asked to go down the mountain and go to Gui Yuanzong by himself.
Naturally, Han Lin didn't know where Guiyuan Sect was.
However, the withered old man had already made arrangements for him to go to the nearby Shuanghe Town, saying that on the fifteenth day of the first lunar month, someone from the Guiyuan Sect would come there to select fairy seedlings.
He just needs to attend on time and follow the Guiyuan Sect's procedures, and he will be able to join smoothly.
